sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Erosion (nullifies effects that penetrate nullifying or invulnerability effects when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 150 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
-Target: all allies. Applies a Greater Counter Heal that restores 10% HP when attacked for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).

-During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the values of the Dark and Time element weakening effects on monsters are increased by 10%.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 700. Deal magic damage (Light) 3 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Chipped Blade (nullifies effects that penetrate damage reduction or reflection when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 150 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% damage reflection for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 60000
Blind and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70

[Thunder Beast Fatewoven] Kantyu or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
